name: The majority voted in favour of voting immediately on the [motion of dissent](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/divisions/senate/2021-06-24/17) moved by Queensland Senator [Larissa Waters](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/queensland/larissa_waters) (Greens), which means it succeeded.
